title: Glenn Miller Orchestra In the Digital Mood CD, GRP - Very Good
descriptionText: The Glenn Miller Orchestra's "In The Digital Mood" CD is a first edition album released in 1983 by GRP. Featuring Big Band & Swing style music from the 1940s, this CD showcases the iconic Glenn Miller sound in a multicolor jewel case. This import CD is a must-have for fans of jazz and classic music, with English lyrics sung by the talented Glenn Miller Orchestra. Perfect for collectors and music enthusiasts looking to experience the timeless music of Glenn Miller in a high-quality digital format.
